raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for your interest in Cedar Systems. We understand that your team has previously inquired about fragmented reporting and workflow coordination. However, we’ve noted some conflicting information regarding the current project status—specifically, that the project is paused and there is disagreement about the requirement.

To ensure we align with your needs and provide the best support, could you please clarify the current status and requirements for the project? This will help us prepare for any next steps and ensure a productive discussion.

Looking forward to your response.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
questions: What is the current status of the project?
Can you clarify the requirement for workflow coordination and reporting?
uncertainties: There is conflicting information about the project status and requirements.
